basic_info.description: Located in a classic 1920s building in the heart of Russian Hill, Unit #7 is a warm and inviting  1BD/1BA TIC offering approximately 559 square feet of thoughtfully preserved charm and modern amenities. This home features a renovated kitchen with quartz countertops, hardwood floors, period molding, and a stunning original fireplace. It is full of timeless character and modern amenities, such as its own laundry room with a washer/dryer included. Unit #7 also features a private deck off of the bedroom with a newly installed door. Set within a secure, gated building with intercom entry and a peaceful garden walkway, residents also enjoy access to a shared rooftop deck with sweeping views of the city and Golden Gate Bridge ideal for relaxing or entertaining. With a stellar 97 Walk Score, you're just steps from Russian Hill's beloved cafes, shops, restaurants, cable cars, and MUNI bus routes. A Sirkin TIC agreement is in place, and HOA financials are professionally managed by Avenues HOA Financial Management.
